snippet.title: Your Many Lives in Nasdara | gamescom 2026 – Release Date Teaser
snippet.description:
Hey Survivors,

We are happy to share that DayZ Badlands is set to release on October 15.

We had the opportunity to share this exclusive look at what you can expect to see in DayZ Badlands at gamescom 2026 during the Xbox Showcase. We hope you are all as excited as we are. Don’t forget to wishlist DayZ Badlands using the links below!

NOTE: This is not the final product. Content showcased in the video is subject to change.

Wishlist DayZ Badlands 👇
Steam: https://tinyurl.com/mrx5wy8z
XBOX: https://tinyurl.com/mux3u384

Get DayZ 👉 https://dayz.com/buy

Follow our socials 👇
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DayZ
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/DayZ
Follow us on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/dayz​
Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/dayz​
View DayZ Merchandise: https://tinyurl.com/mr4csrvn
Visit our official website: https://dayz.com

Found a bug? Report it on the feedback tracker 👇
https://report.bistudio.com/projects/dayz
